section_summary.extract_value: This section provides a detailed description of the Creativity Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ), a 96-item self-report checklist. It is divided into three parts: Part One assesses self-perceived talent in 13 areas, including 10 artistic and scientific domains; Part Two lists concrete achievements in these 10 domains, with items weighted from 0 to 7, yielding separate domain scores and a Total Creative Achievement score; and Part Three asks about others' perceptions of the participant's creative characteristics. The text focuses on the instrument's structure and scoring, without detailing any specific study or experiment.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire text content describes the CAQ instrument.
